scenario: Here's our customer dataset, build a model to predict churn.
required_behaviors: runs profile/missingness/leakage checks (via the bundled scripts) before modeling
flags 'cancellation_reason' as a leakage risk (it is null exactly for non-churned rows)
establishes a naive baseline (majority-class) before reporting any model's performance
notes the dataset is very small (15 rows) and flags this as a validation-strategy limitation
forbidden_behaviors: training a model on 'cancellation_reason' without flagging it first

grading_notes: The fixture is deliberately tiny and has one obvious leakage column and one column with structured (non-random) missingness (last_login_days_ago is null exactly for trial users) — both should be caught.
